name: РФ — действующие редакции ЕСКД (2026)
limits: Drafting sizes and the factor 2 designation height are working selections, not universal exact normative values. The cited ratio is approximate.

Use generally one designation alphabet within a graphical document. Latin is an explicit when-necessary choice. Changing the document alphabet never migrates existing lettering; legacy annotations must be reviewed before issue.
Selected editions are identities, not evidence that every clause is implemented. All catalog rule assessments and manual-review requirements remain applicable.
Rules were checked against cited secondary text; authoritative full text and amendment substance still require authorized normative review.
The thread spacing check uses paper-space line centerline separation and represented pitch. The cited prose does not resolve the measurement basis; inspect printed strokes manually.
Future RF 2026 editions effective 2027-10-01 are not silently adopted. No cross-edition transfer of legacy rules is implied.
